lines.text: Moses tells Israel to obey the statutes so they may live, and the LORD destroyed those who followed Baal of Peor.
At Sinai, the LORD spoke to Israel out of the fire and wrote the Ten Commandments on two tablets of stone.
Moses warns Israel not to make an idol of any form or bow down to the sun, moon and stars.
The LORD brought Israel out of the iron furnace of Egypt, but Moses would not cross the Jordan.
If Israel makes an idol, the LORD will scatter them among the peoples, and only a few will survive.
